feedback:
The style plumbing and validation look sound, but the unstyled prompt is not byte-identical to the previous prompt, violating a core cache-compatibility acceptance criterion.

- [major] shipit/art.py:49 Unstyled prompts change whitespace: The previous prompt concatenated `Painterly ` with a string beginning ` digital...`, producing two spaces between “Painterly” and “digital”. `DEFAULT_STYLE_PHRASE` produces only one. This changes the default prompt and its Gemini cache hash, so existing unstyled art cache entries are missed and the no-style output/cache key no longer stays unchanged. The new test only compares `art_prompt(stats, None)` with `art_prompt(stats)`, which is tautological and cannot catch this regression; compare against the exact previous prompt instead.
